algorithm.RC2: Existing augmented gelsd,then TWO existing longdouble-residual/binary64-solve corrections.No normal-equation solve.All three numeric ranks must be full.
algorithm.PR: Existing corrected affine Newton-CG/exact analytic Hessian,full-direction SVD metric,maxiter1000,xtol1e-12;TWO same-objective refinements.No added ridge,gauge constraint,PSD/sign restriction.
algorithm.PR_sufficient_condition: gamma>0,epsilon>0,T tail injective,head A rank LD*d-(LD-1),only nulls are U-independent sum-zero redistributions of c_t*ones(n,n). Check every trial with recorded SVD guards. Extra/ambiguous nulls => REDUCED_GRADIENT_UNQUALIFIED. No pseudoinverse formula at singular HJJ.
algorithm.inner_admission: Both binary64 direct-array and extended J gradient infinity with original margin <=1e-5;existing same-point value/derivative gates,structural/rank gates.Final refined pair max(physical U shift,chart shift)<=1e-6.Old coarse-to-first-refined binary64 shift retained as observation.Old STOP never reclassified.

algorithm.acceptance: Existing SciPy BFGS/re-solved line search and accepted-point nonincrease.Original physical tangent first-order requires BOTH binary64 and extended norms with original margins <=1e-5,not chart-only.
algorithm.limits: 128 distinct initial/trial points/arm,3 inner solves+2 precision states+1 admission per point,384 inner solves/arm,64 accepted BFGS iterations.No arbitrary CPU/RAM/wall cap.
